title: Ordinary strict-system localization data and scalar compatibility
statement:
Let T,Z be schemes and i:Z→T a morphism, and let B be an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of T [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Define the sequence-site base-change functor as identity on the index times pro-etale base change. Its coefficient unit at (n,V) is the ordinary ring inverse/direct-image adjunction unit at B_n(V). Forgetting commutativity gives the module unit. Define push as module pushforward along this unit, pull as its canonical left adjoint, and adjunction as that canonical adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, lem-pur-ringed-site-module-pullback-exists-universes]. Define levelUnit, levelPull and levelAdjunction by the same constructions at one coefficient index.

Define ClosedData(i,B) to package additivity and preservation of finite limits and finite colimits for pull and push, a push/evaluation isomorphism that is identity on the actual additive sections, a pull/evaluation isomorphism to the actual level pullback, an isomorphism of that pullback to the small-model pro-etale module inverse image, and the equation carrying the evaluated system unit to the level unit under those comparisons. It contains no open operation or exact localization sequence.

For an object U of the pro-etale site of T, define SequenceData(i,U,B) to package an ordinary open datum [def-pur-sequence-site-open-data] and its Transitions predicate, the same closed-operation fields, and monicity, epicity and exactness of its actual open counit followed by its actual closed unit on every unbounded integer cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

For a compatible map of coefficient sequences φ:B→D, let scalar be restriction along its actual sequence-ring map [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], openScalar the restricted map on the open slice, and closedScalar the inverse-image coefficient map. For supplied P:SequenceData(i,U,B), Q:SequenceData(i,U,D), define ScalarCompatibility(P,Q,φ) to package the four operation/scalar comparisons. Require openPull and closedPush to be identities on the underlying additive sections; require the openPush comparison to preserve the actual open counit and closedPull/closedPush to preserve the actual closed unit, with exactly the equations in the Lean record. The original definitions and already proved unit-naturality and coefficient-compatibility theorems are relocated verbatim; ClosedData is their closed-only subrecord.
